mapper.sql: ORDER BY COALESCE(p.display_order, t.display_order), COALESCE(t.parent_id, t.id), CASE WHEN t.parent_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.display_order, t.id
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.status, t.display_order, t.category_id, t.assignee_id, t.start_date, t.due_date, t.parent_id, p.title AS parent_title, c.name AS category_name, c.color AS category_color, a.name AS assignee_name FROM todos t LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN assignees a ON a.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN todos p ON p.id = t.parent_id

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.status, t.display_order, t.category_id, t.assignee_id, t.start_date, t.due_date, t.parent_id, p.title AS parent_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos child WHERE child.parent_id = t.id) AS child_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos child WHERE child.parent_id = t.id AND child.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_child_count, c.name AS category_name, c.color AS category_color, a.name AS assignee_name FROM todos t LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN assignees a ON a.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN todos p ON p.id = t.parent_id
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completed_tasks FROM todos t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM todos child WHERE child.parent_id = t.id)

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.status, t.display_order, t.category_id, t.assignee_id, t.start_date, t.due_date, t.parent_id, p.title AS parent_title, c.name AS category_name, c.color AS category_color, a.name AS assignee_name FROM todos t LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN assignees a ON a.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN todos p ON p.id = t.parent_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM todos WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, title FROM todos WHERE parent_id IS NULL
AND id != #{taskId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM todos child WHERE child.parent_id = #{taskId})
ORDER BY display_order, id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM todos WHERE parent_id = #{parentId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (title, status, display_order, category_id, assignee_id, start_date, due_date, parent_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{status}, #{displayOrder}, #{categoryId}, #{assigneeId}, #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{dueDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{parentId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET title = #{title}, status = #{status}, category_id = #{categoryId}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, start_date = #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, due_date = #{dueDate,jdbcType=DATE}, parent_id = #{parentId,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE id = #{id}
